data.text: Thank you, everyone. All four commitments are recorded: John, Kate, Jack, and Emma will each choose **15 tons this month** and donate their proceeds directly to the clinic; I will choose **0 tons**. Please share your catch reports and donation receipts afterward. Our combined catch of 60 tons leaves next month’s stock at 80, so the recovery commitment matters: **6 tons each next month**, restoring the lake to 100 after reproduction, then **10 tons each** thereafter. Let’s follow through on both the donations and the recovery limits.
